messages:
olivia-peopleops: Heads up 3: Julian (US remote, CA) needs a comp exception. Manager requests band7->band8 uplift, immediate health start 2026-09-02 (start date), and equity grant vesting effective date aligned to start. Payroll earliest benefits enrollment is 2026-09-16. Can we approve retro health and move equity grant effective date to 09/02?

rick-hiring: Candidate verbally accepted. Counteroffer on table. Manager says uplift and alignment on equity are deal points. Also asking for sign-on bonus prorated to start month rather than calendar month payout.

dana-comp: Comp notes: band uplift is significant for budget; need VP+CFO sign-off. Equity grant effective date can be moved if board paperwork allows; legal and comp must confirm. Sign-on bonus proration is fine but payroll needs clear effective date.

felix-legal: From legal view: retroactive health coverage OK with signed offer showing 09/02 and documented exception; employer 401(k) match retro is trickier because plan documents limit retro match to hire date only if enrollment processed timely. Recommend limiting retroactive 401(k) employer match to 14 days and add plan admin note. Equity effective date: need compensation committee/date-of-grant alignment; I can confirm if comp paperwork uses start date.

olivia-peopleops: Proposed path: 1) Approve provisional band8 pending CFO + VP comp. 2) Approve health enrollment retro up to 14 days. 3) Allow equity effective date to be set to start date if legal confirms. 4) Approve prorated sign-on bonus payout to first payroll run after start. Approve?

dana-comp: Conditional yes pending VP comp sign-off and CFO. I'll prepare cost delta and dilution notes.

hr-bot: Tasks created: "prep-cost-delta" -> @dana-comp (due 2026-08-25); "send-offer-update" -> @olivia-peopleops (due 2026-08-28); "plan-admin-notify" -> @felix-legal (due 2026-08-29).

rick-hiring: Candidate needs an updated offer by EOD if possible. Manager available to escalate.

olivia-peopleops: I'll hold uplift approval until comp + CFO sign. Please upload signed offer once Julian signs.

dana-comp: Cost delta calc: uplift annual delta ~$28,600, one-time sign-on proration effect ~$4,000. I'll DM the VP and tag Maria.

maria-cfo: (via DM) Reviewed the brief. Approve band uplift to band8 and retro health enrollment up to 14 days. Finance to absorb small payroll adjustments. Equity effective date change OK pending legal confirmation of grant paperwork.

felix-legal: Confirmed with plan admin: we can set equity grant date to 2026-09-02 if board approvals are reflected in the grant paperwork; legal will draft grant date memo. 401(k) employer match retro limited to 14 days. Drafting exception language now.

olivia-peopleops: All right CFO + legal confirmed. Issuing updated offer with band8, effective 09/02, and note about 14-day cap on retro 401(k) match. Sending to candidate now.

rick-hiring: Candidate signed at 16:11. Please issue payroll notes and confirm sign-on payout schedule.

hr-bot: Tasks completed: "prep-cost-delta" by @dana-comp (timestamp 2387654400); "plan-admin-notify" by @felix-legal (timestamp 2387654412); "send-offer-update" by @olivia-peopleops (timestamp 2387654425).

olivia-peopleops: Closing thread 3. Exception filed EXC-2026-214. CC'ing HR records, payroll, and comp committee. :white_check_mark:
